troubleshooting.title: Satellite Node Shows Red LED
troubleshooting.shortdesc: A satellite node is showing a solid red LED and is not communicating with the mesh.

condition.title: Condition
condition.p: The Aria app shows a satellite node with a red icon, and devices in that area of your home have no Wi-Fi signal. The main node and any other satellite nodes are working normally.

cause.title: Cause
cause.p: The satellite node may be placed too far from the nearest node, and the mesh signal is too weak to maintain a stable backhaul connection.

step.cmd: Open the Aria app and tap the offline node to see its last known signal strength.
Move the node to a location closer to an adjacent node — typically no more than two rooms away.
Wait one minute for the node to attempt to reconnect. The LED should change to white when the connection is established.

cause.title: Cause
cause.p: The node may have lost power or experienced a firmware error.

step.cmd: Unplug the node's power cable and wait 30 seconds.
Plug the power cable back in and wait two minutes for the node to restart.

Check the Aria app to confirm the node's status has returned to green. If the node remains red after restarting, perform a factory reset by pressing and holding the reset button on the base of the node for 10 seconds.
